data.long_meaning: Ghanshyam is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, originating from the Hindu mythology. It is considered a name of Lord Krishna, who is the god of wealth and abundance. The name Ghanshyam is believed to bestow prosperity, wealth, and happiness upon the bearer. The name Ghanshyam carries the meaning “Lord of wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ghanshyam usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
